# Diogo N. Moura

> Strategy operator for scale-up founders. Porto-based, works globally. Twelve years across Corporate and Consulting, currently as an Executive — most recently in the automotive technology sector at Mercedes-Benz.io, previously at EY and Accenture.

## What he does

Fractional, advisory, or short engagements with scale-up founders. Four engagement flavours, most engagements blend two:

- **Strategic clarity** — frame ambiguous problems sharply enough to be decided in a room. Deliverable is a decision, not a 60-slide deck.
- **AI strategy** — operating model and governance, not theatre. Designed an internal AI strategy from scratch in a recent corporate role.
- **Programme rescue** — restabilise governance, rebuild stakeholder trust, ship to production when something has gone off-track.
- **Operating model & cost** — roles, decision rights, rituals, and the cost base underneath.

## Selected engagements (most recent first)

- **Designed an internal AI strategy** — operating model, governance framework, adoption roadmap. The kind of AI work designed to outlast the next vendor pivot. (Corporate, 2026)
- **Recovered a critical Data Warehouse programme** that had gone off-track and shipped it to production. Restabilised governance, rebuilt stakeholder confidence, delivered the launch. (Corporate, 2025 → present)
- **Built a workforce plan for international scaling** — coordinating cross-functional teams across resource allocation and performance. The unglamorous scaffolding underneath any growth story: who, where, when, how many. (Corporate, 2024 → present)
- **Drove a cost transformation that delivered 55% in annual savings** through partnership renegotiation, resource optimisation, and rightsizing — without breaking the operation. (Corporate, 2023)
- **Stood up an office from zero.** +20% headcount in year one as part of a global expansion play. Took the strategic case from board approval through hiring, governance, and the first year of operation. Now part of the executive board overseeing it. (Corporate, 2021)
- **Architected a 10-year technology & innovation roadmap for a major utility.** Long-horizon investment direction. (Consulting, 2020)
- **Led a PMO for a large-scale software implementation** — 15+ concurrent initiatives in logistics and transportation. Programme governance at scale: cadence, dependencies, escalations. (Consulting, 2018)
- **Led human-capital transformation across 25+ countries** and 8-country APAC integration teams. End-to-end process design, systems integration, testing at scale. (Consulting, 2017)

## Background

- **Now:** Head of Corporate Strategy & Growth, Executive Board Member at Mercedes-Benz.io Portugal.
- **Previous:** EY (2017–2021), Accenture (2015–2017).
- **Education:** Integrated Master in Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Porto (2009–14). Post-graduation in Applied Management, NOVA School of Business and Economics — Distinction (2018–19). Certificate in Executive Presence and Influence, INSEAD (2022–23). McKinsey Forward Program (2024).
- **Languages:** Portuguese (native), English (full proficiency), Spanish (basic).
- **Based:** Porto, Portugal. Works globally.

## Audience

Scale-up founders. Not corporate boards, not enterprise procurement. People making decisions where the cost of getting it wrong is months of runway.
